Card Q&A.a: Yes. During your turn, this Digimon is treated as both a red and black Digimon, so it can digivolve into a Digimon with black digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: Can this Digimon digivolve into a Digimon with “Red/Level 5” digivolution requirements?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. [Your Turn] effects don't activate from breeding areas, so the card isn't treated as a red card. You can't digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a red Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: This card is in my breeding area. Can I digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a red Digimon?

Effect: [Your Turn] This Digimon is also treated as red.
